content.short: Axis is a global liquidity provider for tokenized markets, offering yield from arbitrage strategies.
content.description: Axis is a liquidity provider for tokenized markets that monitors prices across trading venues and executes risk-managed trades when it finds discrepancies, passing the resulting yield to depositors. It reports tens of millions of dollars in TVL and more than $110 billion in volume traded across 14 venues. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Axis.
content.meta: Axis is a liquidity provider for tokenized markets offering arbitrage-driven yield, listed in the Plasma ecosystem.
